messages:
sana: Heads-up — I'm landing a change to consolidate per-model ConfigMaps into a single k8s ConfigMap named `model-configs` (JSON blob keyed by model id). Branch: sana/conv-model-configs. This touches kustomize overlays + terraform k8s provider. Any blockers?

mike: Do we still keep the checksum annotation on Deployments? We rely on it to force rollouts when the config changes.

sana: Yes, plan is to compute sha256 on the `model-configs` data and add `checksum/configmap: <sha>` via kustomize/terraform patch. Example patch I'm experimenting with:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: model-server
  annotations:
    checksum/configmap: "${sha}"
```

jordan: Scale question — embedding all models into one ConfigMap could hit etcd limits if we grow a lot. What size are we expecting?

sana: Right now ~12 models, ~2KB each config => ~24KB. We should plan for 100 models (~200KB). etctd limit is 1MB for object size so comfy for now but we should add monitoring.

liz: Another option is projected volume mount of a secret/configmap and let in-pod sidecar watch and reload. That avoids kube rollout churn but means no automatic Deployment restart. Any preference?

mike: We purposely want a Deployment rollout on config change so runtime process picks up new defaults without sidecars. Rolling via checksum is simpler for ops.

sana: Agreed. Also planning a lightweight migration job that reads existing per-model ConfigMaps and writes them into `model-configs` key. Will include drift detection to not clobber any edits.

mike: Quick FYI, here's the terraform snippet I'm pushing in the PR to synthesize the checksum (rough):
```hcl
data "kubernetes_config_map" "model_configs" {
  metadata {
    name      = "model-configs"
    namespace = var.namespace
  }
}

resource "kubernetes_deployment" "model_server" {
  metadata {
    annotations = {
      "checksum/configmap" = md5(data.kubernetes_config_map.model_configs.data["all_models.json"])
    }
  }
  # ...
}
```

jordan: md5 is fine but prefer sha256 if straightforward. Also add a test in infra-ci that modifies the config and asserts the Deployment `metadata.annotations` changed.

sana: Good call — will switch to sha256 and add a small terratest that patches `data.all_models.json` and validates the annotation diff.

liz: One more: consider splitting models by team label into different top-level keys (or split ConfigMaps) if we expect hot reloads for only a few teams — reduces churn across unrelated models.

sana: Noted — I'll add a TODO in the PR to evaluate sharding once we hit 50 models. For now keep single map for simpler rollout and less k8s objects.

mike: @sana please also add the `checksum/configmap` to the kustomize overlay so dev/stage/prod pick it up. I'll review the TF after you push tests. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for cluster=dev, release=sana/conv-model-configs, rollout=1/3 :rocket:

sana: Thanks — pushed updates to PR, added migration job and terratest. Ping me if you want to review TF details.

jordan: LGTM from infra perspective, thanks for the migration plan.

liz: Will follow up if we need projected volume option for edge cases.

mike: Reviewing now. If no blockers I'll approve later today. :eyes:
